column1: # Lemurian ship departure: the party leaves Gondowan and sets course for Lemuria.

column3: Gondowan is behind us.\nWe cannot turn back.{end_wait}
We've come so far.\nSomehow the end still\nfeels out of reach.{end_wait}
I keep thinking about\nhow things were\nbefore we left Vale.{end_wait}
If we find {actor_name:6},\nwill this finally\nbe over?{end_now}
Finding her won't\nundo what happened.\nWe still have choices.{end_wait}
A choice? After all\nwe've been through?{end_wait}
I wonder what Lemuria\nis really like.{end_wait}
We can't just leave\n{actor_name:6} out there,\ncan we?{end_now}
I've never been\nthis far from land.\nIt's unsettling.{end_wait}
Kraden wanted me\nto see the sea.\nNow I understand why.{end_wait}
These waves are rough.\nCan this ship really\ncarry us through?{end_now}
It's a Lemurian ship.\nIf any vessel can,\nthis one should.{end_wait}
I hope you're right.\nWe're far from shore.{end_wait}
{actor_name:6} is out there.\nWe can't stop now.{end_wait}
